identification: Moorcroft Leaf and Berry (autumn leaves with blackberries) small globular/ovoid vase on a deep cobalt blue ground, short neck and foot, about 11 cm. Tube-lined, not flambe, not salt glaze. Base: impressed MADE IN ENGLAND plus the blue-printed facsimile 'W. Moorcroft' signature with 'POTTER TO H.M. THE QUEEN' over a blue brush wash. That printed royal warrant mark was used for Queen Mary's warrant (from 1928), so this is most likely c.1928-1953 (William, or early Walter). No bids yet, opening bid A$50, estimate A$150-200.
